text:
If you’re heading out for a walk or some time by the water, today is delivering the quiet, cool version of September. It’s mostly clear and just 57 in Burlington late this morning, with the north wind barely showing up, but there’s plenty of sun left and the afternoon should climb toward 64. The lake is calm at a foot or less, so this is a good window for an easy waterfront outing. Clouds increase tonight, with temperatures settling near 45 and south winds building enough to push waves up to 1 to 2 feet.

Sunday is the sharp turn: widespread showers arrive after 8am, with a 90% chance of rain, a high near 57, and a quarter to half-inch possible. South winds on the lake could reach 15 to 25 knots, with gusts around 30 and waves building to 2 to 4 feet. Enjoy the dry afternoon today, and be off the broad water before Sunday’s rougher conditions arrive.
